mapper.select: SELECT *,ST_AsText(point) AS pointGeom FROM xian_reservoir_list WHERE ST_Intersects(point, ST_GeomFromText(#{wktPolygon}, 4490)) OR ST_Within(point, ST_GeomFromText(#{wktPolygon}, 4490))

SELECT *, ST_AsText(point) AS pointGeom FROM xian_reservoir_list WHERE ST_DWithin( ST_Transform(point, 3857), ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{centerLon}, #{centerLat}), 4490), 3857), #{radiusMeters} )
